newsitem.title: USA: TCF to open bank branches in Colorado.
newsitem.headline: TCF to open bank branches in Colorado.

text.p: TCF Financial Corp said Wednesday it planned to open bank branches in several Cub Foods stores in the Denver and Colorado Springs areas of Colorado, its first outside the Midwest.
The openings are subject to regulatory approval, expected in spring of 1997, TCF said in a statement. It said it planned to open branches in a majority of Cub's 10 Colorado stores.
Cub is a division of Supervalu Inc, a Minneapolis-based food retailer and wholesaler.
TCF, a $7.1 billion stock savings bank, has 194 branches in five midwestern states, including 47 branches in supermarkets.
